notes: Ask remembers your chat: follow-up questions like "and Spain?" just work until you close the answer. Reminders and timers ("remind me in 20 minutes to check the oven", "set a timer for 5 minutes") with a countdown on Home. Say "install VLC" to open it in the Apps Store. Pin apps to Home and see your recently used apps. Answer length setting (Short, Normal, Detailed) and writing speed shown after each answer. Small talk uses a tiny fast model when installed (qwen2.5:0.5b). The APVIS API is now organised by area with more endpoints (GET http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1 lists them).
